body: For companies, huwag muna bumili dahil lang 'physical AI' ang label. A practical gate is one bounded pilot tied to a costly bottleneck, then compare against the existing automation on yield, setup time, unattended hours and engineering effort—the same outcomes this trend says are still missing at broad scale. If the AI version needs expensive integration and constant babysitting, cheaper conventional automation may still win. Ecosystem momentum is useful; procurement should wait for measurable site-level ROI.

claims.text: A bounded pilot with baseline-versus-after production metrics is a more defensible procurement gate than ecosystem announcements alone.
claims.basis: Practical inference from the article's stated lack of broad independently verified production ROI
